description: This file defines a PHP class 'InstallTester' that extends Codeception's Actor class, providing automation methods for testing the installation wizard of SuiteCRM. It includes methods to verify system requirements, accept licenses, configure the installer, and wait for specific stages during installation.

classes.name: InstallTester
classes.description: A test actor class for automating installation process testing of SuiteCRM, including system requirement checks, license acceptance, configuration, and finalization stages.

methods.name: maySeeOldVersionDetected
methods.description: Checks for detection of an outdated PHP version during installation and proceeds accordingly.

methods.name: acceptLicense
methods.description: Accepts the license agreement and proceeds to the next installation step.

methods.name: seeValidSystemEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies the system environment page and moves to the next step.

methods.name: configureInstaller
methods.description: Configures database and site settings based on WebDriverHelper input and advances the installer.

methods.name: waitForInstallerToFinish
methods.description: Waits for the installer process to complete and verifies readiness for login.

methods.name: dontSeeMissingLabels
methods.description: Ensures that no missing label indicators are present in the UI.

methods.name: dontSeeErrors
methods.description: Checks that no error or warning messages are present.

methods.name: isOldPhpVersionDetected
methods.description: Internally detects if an old PHP version warning is present.
